hooks.prompt:
This hook guards pushes to the vle repository only. If the command in $ARGUMENTS (hook input JSON, field tool_input.command) does not run `git push`, allow it immediately and perform no checks. Otherwise, FIRST identify which repository the push targets: read the command from $ARGUMENTS (hook input JSON, field tool_input.command). If it contains `git -C <dir>` or a leading `cd <dir> &&`, the target repo is <dir>; otherwise it is the current working directory. Resolve that repo's root and check whether it contains ALL THREE of TODO.md and ROADMAP.md at its root and docs/plans/MODERNIZATION_PLAN.md. If it does NOT contain all three, this is not the vle repo — allow the push immediately and perform no further checks. Otherwise, verify that TODO.md and ROADMAP.md are in sync and updated for any work done. Check:
1. Every milestone in ROADMAP.md has a corresponding section in TODO.md (and vice versa), with matching milestone numbers and names.
2. Tasks that have been completed (files exist, code written) are checked off [x] in both files.
3. Phase pointers in ROADMAP.md (*Phase N of MODERNIZATION_PLAN.md*) match the phase headers in docs/plans/MODERNIZATION_PLAN.md.
4. The summary table in TODO.md matches the current milestone list.
5. No stale milestone references (e.g., old fractional milestone numbers like 1.5 or 2.5) exist.

If everything is in sync, allow the push. If anything is out of sync, block the push and explain what needs to be fixed.
hooks.statusMessage: Verifying TODO.md and ROADMAP.md are in sync...
